scientific_intent.scientific_task: Normalize independent rows of logits into nonnegative distributions.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Subtract row maximum, sum exp(logit-max), then divide each exponential by that sum.
invariants: Positive outputs and each row sums to one within roundoff.
Adding a constant to all finite logits in a row leaves softmax unchanged.
accuracy_requirements: Every Float32 output checked with source-based absolute tolerance 1e-3 and full dual-reference artifacts.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: exp approximation, serial reduction rounding and stability for large logit ranges; subtract-max retained.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Native naive mode0 only, 8192x128 and ten repeats; optimized cooperative mode1 remains unported/unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Probability normalization primitive common in ML; source alone does not identify a model or domain science dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Measured mode0 is serial within each row; results do not describe available optimized native mode1 or all softmax implementations.
scientific_intent.review_phase: retrospective source annotation, no new GPU runs
